The rules do not automatically grant regrowing heads or a mandatory weakness to fire. The party may need to prepare a crossing, secure an escape route, and discover why the hydra moved toward a settlement. Luring it away from the road or resolving the original environmental disturbance can be a complete expedition objective.

strings.Každé kolo může zaútočit na 2 různé cíle: Each round, may attack 2 different targets; both attacks suffer −2 to their final ATTACK. Reduces the first two instances of damage it takes each round by 3 (minimum 0).

best/wyverna.name: Wyvern
profile: A wyvern is a large winged monster with a predatory body and a dangerous venomous stinger. In Elaria, it nests on cliffs, high ruins, and mountain outcrops overlooking the surrounding countryside. Remains of prey beneath its nest and marks left by large talons reveal its presence. Although it may resemble a dragon at first glance, its behavior is driven mainly by hunting and defending its own territory.

It often lives alone or in a pair with young. It is observant and can exploit favorable conditions, but this profile does not grant it a dragon's learning or a desire to build a vast hoard. It seeks food and a safe nesting place. It may attack herds if they offer easier prey than mountain animals. If it serves a person or another master, the relationship must arise from specific breeding, training, or magic.

Once per battle, Poisonous Stinger adds two damage after a physical hit, provided the base attack actually dealt damage. This is not automatically long-term poisoning or an extra attack without a condition. Height, open space, and available cover change the danger of the encounter. The party can locate the nest, prevent further attacks on herds, or help an owner recover an escaped monster. Understanding the cause of its behavior often helps choose between direct confrontation, securing the surrounding area, and changing the route.

strings.1× za souboj po fyzickém zásahu přidá 2: Once per battle, adds 2 damage after a physical hit; this bonus cannot be used if the base attack dealt 0 damage.

best/mlady-drak.name: Young Dragon
profile: A young dragon is already a very dangerous being, but is still gaining experience and establishing its own position. In Elaria, it seeks a remote lair in mountains, ruins, or deep forests, with room and supplies. It may belong to a dragon lineage that has long controlled the territory, or be an individual driven from its home. The first objects collected in its lair may reveal what it values and where it comes from.

It is intelligent and can learn from conversations and conflicts. It often acts alone, but may seek an older dragon's recognition, alliances, or servants of its own. It wants safety, food, and control over its territory. Youth may bring curiosity, pride, and poor judgment of consequences. Stealing supplies or threatening a settlement may be a calculated attempt to gain power or a reckless effort to imitate an older relative.

Once per battle, Dragon Breath allows a magical attack against up to two targets, while Dragon Scales reduces the first instance of physical damage each round. The particular dragon determines the nature of its breath; there is no need to assume that all share the same element. The party can negotiate territorial boundaries, uncover why the young dragon's behavior changed, or offer a way out of a dangerous dispute. Direct confrontation requires prepared defenses and a retreat. An agreement may be possible if the dragon sees a real benefit and need not interpret it as public humiliation.

strings.1× za souboj napadne až 2 cíle magickým: Once per battle, attacks up to 2 targets with a magical attack with a spell bonus of +3, rolling separately against each. Dragon Scales reduces the first instance of physical damage each round by 2 (minimum 0).

best/dospely-drak.name: Adult Dragon
profile: An adult dragon is an experienced, intelligent being whose presence can influence the entire surrounding territory. A lair in a mountain fortress, extensive underground chambers, or a remote ruin is more than a resting place: it may hold supplies, keepsakes, valuables, and records of old agreements. Its origins and lineage may reach back to events local people know only through legends. Its relationship with the territory is usually far longer than any individual ruler's lifetime.

It generally makes its own decisions and can plan far into the future. It may maintain servants, allies, or dependent settlements without sharing an ordinary home with other dragons. It seeks security, influence, and things it values; knowledge or a fulfilled oath may be as valuable to it as gold. Its nature varies. An adult dragon may be a destructive tyrant, a steadfast guardian of an agreement, or a being that regards short-lived human disputes as disturbances of its peace.

Once per battle, Dragon Breath can strike up to two targets. Ancient Scales reduces the first instance of physical damage and the first instance of magical damage each round. If the party discovers and actually exploits its particular weakness, this reduction stops applying and both defenses drop by two. Investigating the weakness is therefore an important part of the expedition; the particular story determines its nature, and clues must support it. An agreement, repairing a broken promise, or an offer that removes the real cause of the dragon's hostility may be equally significant.

strings.1× za souboj napadne až 2 cíle magickým: Once per battle, attacks up to 2 targets with a magical attack with a spell bonus of +4; each defends separately. Reduces the first instance of physical damage and the first instance of magical damage each round by 2. If the party discovers and actually exploits its particular weakness, this reduction does not apply and the dragon suffers −2 PDEF and MDEF.
strings.Dračí dech; Staré dračí šupiny a odhalen: Dragon Breath; Ancient Scales and Revealed Weakness

best/prastary-drak.name: Ancient Dragon
profile: An ancient dragon has survived changes to empires, landscapes, and human lineages. Its lair may be a place with its own history, extensive defenses, and objects that mattered long before today's settlements existed. In Elaria, its name may appear in chronicles in several forms because different cultures interpreted the same being differently. Its territory is usually carefully chosen, and changes in the surrounding area rarely go unnoticed.

It is highly intelligent, experienced, and generally accustomed to acting from a position of overwhelming advantage. It may rule a network of allies, influence its surroundings indirectly, or remain apart until someone disrupts its long-term plan. It seeks to preserve what it considers essential: power, memory, a promise, territory, or a particular person. Age alone means neither malice nor flawless wisdom. Long solitude and confidence in its own strength may cause it to underestimate decisions made by people whose lives seem brief to it.

Dragon Breath threatens up to two targets, while Elder Scales reduces the first instance of physical damage and the first instance of magical damage each round by three. Actually exploiting its particular weakness cancels the reduction and lowers physical and magical defense by four. Direct combat without prior investigation is therefore extraordinarily dangerous. The party can gather old accounts, discover the significance of a guarded object, and negotiate over an objective the dragon does not consider trivial. Both a weakness and the possibility of agreement need clear story clues, so success follows from understanding and preparation.

strings.1× za souboj napadne až 2 cíle magickým: Once per battle, attacks up to 2 targets with a magical attack with a spell bonus of +4; each defends separately. Reduces the first instance of physical damage and the first instance of magical damage each round by 3. If the party discovers and actually exploits its particular weakness, this reduction does not apply and the dragon suffers −4 PDEF and MDEF.
strings.Dračí dech; Prastaré dračí šupiny a odha: Dragon Breath; Elder Scales and Revealed Weakness

best/goblini-nacelnik.name: Goblin Chieftain
profile: A goblin chieftain leads a group whose safety and livelihood depend on quick decisions. The chieftain may come from a respected family, rise through cunning, or earn authority by defending the band. The leader lives in a protected part of a cave camp, ruins, or an abandoned mine. Supplies, important information, and objects others recognize as signs of rank gather around this position.

The chieftain is a more intelligent and influential opponent than a lone goblin. The leader knows the group's needs and can use both fear and the hope of reward. A chieftain may decide independently or hand over loot to a stronger patron whom the group cannot afford to disobey. Supplies, safety, and maintaining authority are central concerns. Violence toward neighbors may be a choice or the result of pressure the party does not yet understand. Relationships with guards, families, and other important goblins reveal the real foundations of the chieftain's rule.

Chieftain's Orders strengthens one goblin ally's attack each round while the chieftain is conscious. Once per battle, Cunning Dodge increases defense against a declared attack. The party can discover whose support sustains the leader, interrupt the supply of loot, or offer a solution to a shared threat. Negotiations should account for the chieftain's need to justify an agreement before the band. Defeating one leader alone may not remove the hunger, fear, or patron that caused the conflict.

strings.Dokud je při vědomí, 1 spojenec Goblin n: While conscious, one allied Goblin or Goblin Archer gains +1 to its final ATTACK each round. Once per battle, after an attack's target is declared, the chieftain gains +2 DEFENSE against that attack.

best/orci-nacelnik.name: Orc Chieftain
profile: An orc chieftain leads a group whose strength rests on warriors, supplies, and the ability to defend its territory. In Elaria, the leader may come from a respected lineage, gain leadership through a duel, or establish authority as a protector of the community. The seat of power may be a fortified camp, a mountain settlement, or an occupied fortress. Insignia, equipment, and trophies often commemorate the deeds on which that position rests.

The chieftain can plan and understands relationships within the group. The leader must convince warriors, important families, and other influential people that this leadership brings safety or success. A chieftain may act independently or owe an obligation to a more powerful ally. Goals often include protecting territory, securing resources for the group, recognition, and personal power. Aggressive behavior may arise from tradition, fear of losing authority, or a long-standing dispute with neighbors. Origins and appearance alone do not determine willingness to honor an agreement.

Once per battle, Battle Cry temporarily strengthens the attacks of up to two allies. Battle Fury increases the chieftain's melee attack when below half of maximum HP, so a wounded chieftain remains dangerous. The party can investigate the dispute's cause, negotiate over prisoners, or expose an outside manipulator. An offer must account for how the chieftain will explain it to the community. Removing a genuine threat to that community may produce a stronger agreement than a merely enforced truce.

strings.1× za souboj může před svým útokem zvoli: Once per battle, before attacking, may choose up to 2 allies; they gain +1 to their final ATTACK until the start of the chieftain's next turn. While below half of maximum HP, the chieftain gains +1 to its final melee ATTACK.

best/arcimag.name: Archmage
profile: An archmage is an exceptionally experienced magic user whose knowledge and influence exceed those of an ordinary wizard. An archmage may lead a school, serve as an adviser, manage a protected residence, or work in seclusion for many years. In Elaria, this work leaves behind pupils, research results, and interventions that have affected the wider region. A study, tower, or underground laboratory is a place where everyday life meets power most people do not understand.

An archmage is intelligent and accustomed to thinking several steps ahead. One may direct apprentices, servants, or a community of specialists, or instead avoid anyone who would restrict the work. Goals may include knowledge, protection, influence, or completing a particular project. Long experience provides perspective, but may also strengthen the belief that others cannot judge these decisions. Conflict may arise from a dangerous experiment, concealed consequences, or a goal for which the archmage is willing to sacrifice other people's safety.

Once per battle, Chain Lightning allows magical attacks against up to two targets. The Power Crystal supports defense against the first physical attack each round and strengthens the archmage's magic. Destroying or taking away the crystal removes this protection, reduces the spell bonus to +1 and magical protection to zero; the resulting magical attack is 14 and magical defense is 13. The party can prepare a way to disconnect the crystal safely or negotiate an end to a particular plan. The archmage's strength thus has a clear mechanical dependency that can be discovered and exploited, rather than making the encounter depend solely on trading attacks.

strings.1× za souboj může místo běžného útoku na: Once per battle, replace a normal attack with magical attacks against up to 2 targets (spell bonus +3); roll separately for each. With the crystal, gain +2 PDEF against the first physical attack each round. If the crystal is destroyed or taken, this ends; spell bonus drops +3 → +1 and magical protection +3 → 0 (MATK 14, MDEF 13).

hero/clovek-bojovnik.name: Human – Warrior
profile: A human warrior suits a player who wants to begin with a straightforward role and gradually find a personal style. The character might be a bridge guard, an experienced warrior's apprentice, or a villager who decided to protect others. The story rests on choices rather than exceptional ancestry: whom to help, what to learn, and when to favor negotiation over a drawn sword.

Within the party, the warrior helps keep danger away from more vulnerable allies and gives them room to make decisions. The character may guard a retreat, accompany a negotiator, or hold an important passage. The role is useful outside combat too: protecting travelers, preparing an expedition, and handling situations where someone needs support. Courage may mean admitting a mistake or choosing a safer route, rather than accepting every challenge.

The racial ability Adaptability allows a reroll after the character's own failed roll once per adventure. Vaelor creates a new random permutation, the player chooses a number again, and the better of the two results is used. The class adds Protect: once per battle, the warrior may take an attack directed at a nearby ally. The attack is resolved against the warrior's defense instead. Choose starting equipment according to the requirements this particular hero meets. The listed values form the basis of a level-one character; personality, name, relationships, and the reason for adventuring are decided during character creation.

The character may protect a forest road, accompany a messenger, or leave home because of an unfulfilled promise. Within the party, the warrior serves as a defender who watches the surroundings and seeks a good position. A thoughtful approach can complement brute strength, but does not automatically grant an extra special strike.

hero/trpaslik-bojovnik.name: Dwarf – Warrior
profile: A dwarf warrior is a dependable pillar of the party, especially where combat meets stone and underground spaces. The character may come from a mining settlement, serve as the guard of a mountain gate, or search for a missing relative. Strength provides a natural foundation for direct confrontation. Lower agility encourages planning the route, retreat, and position from which to protect the others.

Within the party, the warrior helps keep danger away from more vulnerable allies and gives them room to make decisions.
